reference_boundary: Official OpenAI retention guidance defines risk fields and gates only. ADK remains platform-neutral; local runner behavior must be validated before promotion.

applies_to: hosted tool or hosted skill pilots
quality_gates: store=true or default-stored flows require retention duration and owner approval
store=false or ZDR flows must not rely on server-side persistent state
background mode records polling retention and must not be treated as no-retention
remote MCP tools record third-party data retention boundaries before promotion
hosted containers and hosted skills record active-container lifecycle and deletion condition
prompt cache retention records in_memory versus 24h policy and content boundary
must_not: treat background mode polling state as zero-retention
treat remote MCP provider retention as covered by ADK defaults
store raw reasoning or encrypted reasoning payloads in long-term memory
promote hosted tool pilots without lifecycle and deletion evidence
